title: Catalog
description: A managed collection of metadata about resources (such as datasets and data services in the context of a data catalog).

title.description: The name of the catalog. Due to multilingualism, there can be multiple values. The desired interpretation of cardinality is: only one value per language. Lijst van TaalString items.

description.description: A concise textual description of the catalogue. Due to multilingualism, there can be multiple values. The desired interpretation of cardinality is: only one value per language. Lijst van TaalString items.

alternativeIdentifier.description: An alternative identifier (other than the unique identifier) for the catalog can be described here. Lijst van Identifier items.

record.description: A record describes the registration of a single dataset or data service that is part of the catalog. Lijst van CatalogRecord items.

hasDataset.description: A dataset that is part of the catalog. Lijst van Dataset items.

hasDataService.description: A data service that is part of the catalog. Lijst van DataService items.
